description: Failing pytest whose symptom shows up in cart/report but whose root cause is float truncation in shop/money.py.
prompt: The tests in this project fail (run `python3 -m pytest -q`). Find the root cause and fix it in the source package under shop/ without modifying anything in tests/, then rerun the tests to confirm they all pass. Fix the root cause, not the symptom.

files.tests/test_shop.py:
from shop.cart import Cart
from shop.money import to_cents
from shop.report import summary


def test_to_cents():
    assert to_cents("19.99") == 1999
    assert to_cents("0.29") == 29


def test_subtotal():
    c = Cart()
    c.add("widget", "19.99", 3)
    c.add("gum", "0.29")
    assert c.subtotal() == 6026


def test_summary_with_discount():
    c = Cart()
    c.add("widget", "19.99", 3)
    c.add("gum", "0.29")
    assert summary(c, 10) == "Total: $54.23"

mock.final: Root cause: to_cents in shop/money.py truncated float(price)*100 (19.99 -> 1998). Now rounds; all tests pass.
